CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS garage_recovery_notes_forward BEFORE UPDATE ON garage_recovery_notes
WHEN NEW.network IS NOT OLD.network
  OR NEW.key_fingerprint IS NOT OLD.key_fingerprint
  OR (OLD.account_floor IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.account_floor IS NULL OR NEW.account_floor < OLD.account_floor))
  OR (OLD.read_at IS NOT NULL AND NEW.read_at IS NOT OLD.read_at)

CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS trade_trails_forward BEFORE UPDATE ON trade_trails
WHEN NEW.key_fingerprint IS NOT OLD.key_fingerprint
  OR NEW.robot_index IS NOT OLD.robot_index
  OR NEW.network IS NOT OLD.network
  OR NEW.coordinator_alias IS NOT OLD.coordinator_alias
  OR NEW.order_id IS NOT OLD.order_id
  OR NEW.role IS NOT OLD.role
  OR NEW.version < OLD.version
  OR NEW.read_at < OLD.read_at
  OR NEW.breached < OLD.breached
  OR NEW.history_unknown IS NOT OLD.history_unknown
  OR (OLD.bond_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bond_hash IS NOT OLD.bond_hash)
  OR (OLD.escrow_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.escrow_hash IS NOT OLD.escrow_hash AND NEW.take IS OLD.take)
  OR (OLD.escrow_hash IS NOT NULL AND NEW.escrow_hash IS OLD.escrow_hash AND NEW.take IS NOT OLD.take)
  OR (OLD.bond_step_seen_at IS NOT NULL AND (NEW.bond_step_seen_at IS NULL OR NEW.bond_step_seen_at < OLD.bond_step_seen_at))
  OR (OLD.bond_step_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NEW.bond_step_deadline IS NULL)
  OR (OLD.position IN ('succeeded', 'makerLostDispute', 'takerLostDispute', 'expired', 'cancelled', 'publicAgain', 'notAvailable') AND NEW.position IS NOT OLD.position)
  OR (NEW.take IS NOT OLD.take AND NOT (NEW.take IS OLD.take + 1 AND OLD.position IN ('public', 'paused', 'waitingForBoth', 'waitingForEscrow', 'waitingForPayout') AND NOT (OLD.position = 'waitingForPayout' AND OLD.role = 'buyer') AND OLD.take_deadline IS NOT NULL AND ((NEW.position IN ('waitingForBoth', 'waitingForEscrow', 'waitingForPayout') AND NEW.take_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NEW.take_deadline > OLD.take_deadline AND NEW.seen_late = 0) OR (NEW.position IN ('chatting', 'fiatSent', 'inDispute', 'sendingSats', 'succeeded', 'routingFailed', 'waitingDisputeResolution', 'makerLostDispute', 'takerLostDispute') AND NEW.take_deadline IS OLD.take_deadline AND NEW.taker_hash_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.escrow_hash IS NULL AND (OLD.position IN ('public', 'paused') OR NEW.taker_hash_id IS NOT OLD.taker_hash_id) AND NEW.seen_late = 1)) AND NEW.earlier_escrows IS (OLD.earlier_escrows || coalesce(OLD.escrow_hash || ';', '')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trades WHERE key_fingerprint = OLD.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = OLD.robot_index AND origin = 'madeHere')))
  OR (NEW.take IS OLD.take AND (NEW.earlier_escrows IS NOT OLD.earlier_escrows OR NEW.seen_late IS NOT OLD.seen_late))
  OR (NEW.escrow_hash IS NOT NULL AND instr(';' || NEW.earlier_escrows, ';' || NEW.escrow_hash || ';') > 0)
  OR (OLD.take_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NEW.take_deadline IS NULL)
  OR (OLD.taker_hash_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.taker_hash_id IS NULL)
  OR (OLD.taken_amount IS NOT NULL AND NEW.taken_amount IS NULL)
  OR (NEW.take IS OLD.take AND OLD.take_deadline IS NOT NULL AND NEW.take_deadline IS NOT OLD.take_deadline)
  OR (NEW.take IS OLD.take AND OLD.taker_hash_id IS NOT NULL AND NEW.taker_hash_id IS NOT OLD.taker_hash_id)
  OR (NEW.take IS OLD.take AND OLD.taken_amount IS NOT NULL AND NEW.taken_amount IS NOT OLD.taken_amount)
  OR (NEW.take IS NOT OLD.take AND OLD.taker_hash_id IS NULL AND NEW.taker_hash_id IS NOT NULL)
  OR (NEW.take IS NOT OLD.take AND OLD.taken_amount IS NULL AND NEW.taken_amount IS NOT NULL)
  OR ((NEW.take_deadline IS NOT NULL OR NEW.taker_hash_id IS NOT NULL OR NEW.taken_amount IS NOT NULL) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trades WHERE key_fingerprint = OLD.key_fingerprint AND robot_index = OLD.robot_index AND origin = 'madeHere'))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'a trail only moves forward');
END;
